description: This file implements functions for tiered routing of deployment requests based on tags embedded in request metadata and deployment parameters. It includes logic for validating deployment tags, filtering deployments accordingly, and extracting tags from request metadata. The code is part of a router strategy for managing request routing across different deployment configurations in the Litellm project.
